first_successful_swap: avatar_display.paint_at numeric; native_yuki.py fills latest_stats only after egl.swap succeeds
paired_activation: character_pair.profile_version equals xuefei-yuki-board-v1-candidate and prompt_sha256 equals the frozen978B persona digest
Source trace: swap observer→pair READY→one-shot callback→board_business.activate; failure changes pair to FAILED and cancels owners before subsequent successful publish
API has no direct BoardBusinessRuntime.started/worker-thread-start flag. Do not claim activation from service.enabled alone.
configured_board_business: feedback_error/cleanup_error and state.error should be empty; sampler outputs only their presence booleans
These fields establish local configuration/capabilities, not live ASR/LLM/TTS inference or calibrated speaker identity.
visible_native_performance: Only visible=true and frame_scheduling_active=true spans; hidden page intentionally pauses GL while audio is allowed to continue
FPS is delta avatar_display.frames / delta avatar_display.paint_at over successive successful-swap samples

age_ms measures last swap freshness; stale_frames/rejected_controls/elapsed_dropped_seconds use deltas, not initial absolute values. First swap before the control mailbox becomes ready can contribute one initial stale frame
native_call_ms/evaluate_ms/submit_ms/egl_bind_ms/egl_swap_ms/gtk_callback_ms are sampled last-frame timings. Coarse0.5s API snapshots cannot supply all-frame P95/P99
portrait_offload.pending<=1, inflight_limit=1; offered/replaced are control mailbox statistics, not native presentation drops
avatar_renderer.sequence and top-level sequence measure worker/publication cadence, not native EGL fps
mic_listening_false: playing=false, paused=false, phase=IDLE; do not treat missing fields as false
mechanical_protection: Top-level manual_pan.state=FAULT, pulse_us explicitly null, target_us explicitly null, automatic_following=false
Fields must be present: absence is unknown, not null/false. If pan shell was not composed and manual_pan missing, no mechanical confirmation can be claimed from this endpoint
ui_runtime.snapshot.modules.motion.state is an auxiliary state only; never retain the rest of snapshot (identity/target data)

cpu_pss_plan.pairing: Root can run the existing explicitly PID+birth-pinned resource sampler in the same board monotonic interval. Retain role/CPU ticks or percent/PSS/RSS/counts only; no cmdline, environment, maps, IDs or content. Do not launch another model/load generator.
cpu_pss_plan.correlation: Helper emits started_monotonic/ended_monotonic and each sample elapsed time; pair these with existing resource sample monotonic times.
cpu_pss_plan.limits: Aggregate CPU0..100 and per-process one-core percent are different normalizations; preserve the original resource tool definition. PSS is not video/thermal/power proof.

scope: Missing mechanical field vs present null distinction
Hidden-page intervals excluded from native delta-frame FPS
